entities.name: Hague Agreement Concerning the International Registration of Industrial Designs
entities.label: Text
entities.summary: The Hague Agreement Concerning the International Deposit of Industrial Designs, also known as the Hague system, provides a mechanism for registering an industrial design in several countries by means of a single application, filed in one language, with one set of fees. The system is administered by WIPO.
